Intro

iButton
Design
The
blue
part of the following imageis how you would need to
put the real iButton
so the Flipper can
read it.
The
green
part is how you need to
touch the reader
with the Flipper zero to
correctly emulate an iButton
.
Actions
Read
In Read Mode Flipper is waiting for the iButton key to touch and is able to digest any of three types of keys:
Dallas, Cyfral, and Metakom
. Flipper will
figure out the type of the key itself
. The name of the key protocol will be displayed on the screen above the ID number.
